attributes.name: Aspect of the Wolf
attributes.powers:
Display this card. While displayed, add 1d6 to your Strength and Dexterity checks. 

At the end of your turn, you may examine the top card of your location deck.
attributes.recharge: Then, if you do not have the Divine skill, banish this card; otherwise, discard it, or you may attempt a Divine 10 check to recharge it instead.
